applies_to.quote: These Directions shall be applicable to Urban Co-operative Banks (hereinafter collectively referred to as ‘UCBs’ and individually as a ‘UCB’).

answer.action: Urban Co-operative Banks must implement the concurrent audit system and ensure their Board reviews its effectiveness annually.
answer.action_quote: The Board shall, once in a year, review the effectiveness of the Concurrent Audit system and take necessary measures to correct the lacunae in the system.

effective_date.quote: These Directions shall come into effect immediately upon issuance.
